description: Fresh-host evidence template: installer binds storage_identity to the verified protected registration; all host paths derive from registered data/models roles.
notes: storage_identity must exactly equal the protected registration stable identity (schema, role path/mount/uuid/fstype, and derived roots). Null is intentionally incomplete; no host root or mount identity is implied.
No acquisition or live authentication completion is asserted; incomplete evidence must fail start before Docker activation.
Record launcher_sha256 only after installation from reviewed merged source; the manager compares installed bytes, source bytes and this evidence.
Set auth_gate_passed only after F1D actual pinned-image sentinel launch/setup tests, including final auth layers, diagnostics and failed warmup cleanup; synthetic source tests alone do not qualify.

Write the separate completion manifest only after all 48 pinned artifacts pass SHA256 verification and index/config consistency checks. Never edit the immutable expected F1A manifest to indicate completion.
Keep the existing mode0600 regular nonsymlink API key unchanged; exact 1..4096 printable ASCII bytes with no whitespace or newline.
The completion path is a provisioning placeholder only. A verified instance records its concrete registered path, and immutable completion model_root must match the derived per-model root.
